announcement.quote: If the Reorganization were not approved by shareholders, the Reorganization would not be consummated and the Existing Fund would remain as a series of the Trust.

Excerpts are mostly boilerplate; only the July 2014 PRE 14A passages mention an Existing Fund / New Fund reorganization. The earlier N-14 and 2015-2016 N-14 filings show no party names or outcome in the excerpts. RW filings (2015-08-07, 2015-08-20, 2015-11-20, 2016-01-07) state administrative reasons or concern other filings, not a merger outcome.
